_comment: Every lamp-* binary the workspace builds, by what the lamp-os package does with it (main's scripts/release/lamp_os_package.py reads this). core: the parts, packaged with their units. optional: carried when built, no unit. provisioning: factory tools, in the generic package's tools/. development: never packaged. A new binary goes in one list in the same pull request; CI fails otherwise (tools/package-binaries.sh).
